purpose: Environment/exposure expansion plus targeted scale/hazard audit/refactor: verifies that the cube can name heat, cold, water, smoke, fire, famine, migration route, worksite exposure, infrastructure failure, disaster mortuary language, mass-death scale, ritual delay, and policy-mortality language without becoming emergency, survival, rescue, legal, immigration, occupational, disaster-response, or body-handling advice.
headline_findings: The archive now has a dedicated environment/exposure and scale/hazard layer.
Twenty-four new environment/exposure records were added and all remain quarantined/publication-blocked.
Ten prior records were backfilled into environment_exposure_axis without promoting them.
Seventeen new source cards and seven new review packets were added for heat, cold, drowning, wildfire smoke, famine, migration deaths, disaster dignity, and worker heat exposure.
A new environment-exposure audit tool was added and integrated into make check.
The cube explicitly blocks emergency/survival/rescue/legal/immigration/occupational/disaster-response/body-handling advice and body-condition spectacle.

posture: no public release; all records quarantined; all environment/exposure records blocked pending specialist review
